definitions.theory: Distinguish financing balance from valuation denominator
definitions.direction: Balance increase is a candidate demand proxy; predictive sign not certified
definitions.industry_scope: SW2014 L2/L3; SW2021 L1/L2/L3 subject to qualification
definitions.economic_date: Balance snapshot signal date minus 2 trading sessions; cap at signal date
definitions.available_time: Historical-proxy signal-date construction; strict PIT false
definitions.aggregation: Median on fixed positive complete common companies
definitions.missing_rule: Both original industry endpoints present; >=5 and >=80% of each endpoint membership; else null
definitions.failure: Nonpositive B/P/S, identity or date mismatch, missing members, insufficient history; no zero fill
definitions.notation: fij = median(B_i / (P_j*S_j)) on identical common company cohort
